dataset: FHWA NGSIM Peachtree Street, camera 1, noon recording, November 8 2006
reference_registration_only: Official annotated/rectified video is used only for development geometry and source-time registration. It must never feed the detector.
model: Frozen ATLAS 7 aerial multiscale candidate selected on Lankershim development footage, before Peachtree held-out scoring

source_time.evidence: Raw road-pixel matching at processed frames 600, 1200, 1800 finds raw frames 604, 1204, 1804, including dense one-frame refinement. No held-out images or labels used.
source_time.anomaly: Supplied Global_Time adds millisecond frame increments to a seconds-based origin. Preserve source values; do not interpret the mixed-unit values as uniform Unix milliseconds.

region.scope: Ground road surface visible in camera 1; not all 500 metres of the study area
region.eligibility: Reference body centre projected into a registered road polygon and camera-1 GIS coverage. Same geometric rule for predicted centres. Occluded vehicles within the region remain eligible. No post-outcome ROI shrinking.

metrics.primary: Raw detector/tracker point IDF1 and coverage, visible vehicle count errors
metrics.secondary: Explicitly marked offline short-gap estimates scored separately; never call interpolated boxes actual detector observations
metrics.strict_track_partition: Exclude reference IDs observed during the 0-300 s calibration interval. Report additional fresh-track cohort excluding identities first seen before 600 s, with matching predicted-track birth rule. Do not silently replace the full-window cohort.

physical_reconstruction.native_inputs: CV-derived arrivals/births and measured signal-change schedule, development-only road/lane geometry and behavior parameters. Freeze inputs before loading test interior states.
physical_reconstruction.oracle: Reference-boundary demand diagnostic reported separately from CV-driven end-to-end reconstruction
physical_reconstruction.acceptance: Use all applicable predeclared thresholds in reality-v7-protocol.json, including uncertainty, coverage and actual source signal synchronization. Missing evidence prevents acceptance.
physical_reconstruction.interventions: No controller promotion until physical acceptance; simulated alternatives are never observed field interventions.

coverage: Reference noon trajectory session has frames 5-10208. Complete source video is longer; do not invent annotations for unlabelled footage or present a 25-minute accuracy benchmark.
budget: Free official assets, local CPU; no paid infrastructure
